subject: Training on customer data - opt-out confirmation
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Wu <samantha.wu@acmefin.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Training on customer data - follow-up and next steps

Hi Samantha 

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery:
- You run AcmeFin's customer support automation in EU-only regions and have strict PII handling and residency requirements.
- You asked that any data sent to Redwood endpoints not be used for model training or improvement.
- You expect logs/telemetry to be retained at most 30 days and to exclude full PII wherever possible.

Next steps we discussed:
1) I attached our short training-opt-out-form (PDF) that legally documents the opt-out and the account-level flag we set. Please sign and return so we can process immediately.
2) We also attached a one-page data-handling summary (Data-Handling-Summary.pdf) that outlines retention, logging, and KMS options.
3) Our security lead (cc'd) will loop in to confirm SOC 2 artefacts and answer any technical questions about logs and key management.

What I'll do from Redwood:
- Pre-fill the opt-out form with your account details and email you a DocuSign link.
- Set an internal ticket to (a) set the training opt-out flag, (b) restrict model improvement pools, and (c) pin your inference to EU regions.

If that sounds right, I'll send the DocuSign link this afternoon.

Thanks 
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0193

Attachments: training-opt-out-form.pdf, data-handling-summary.pdf

From: Samantha Wu <samantha.wu@acmefin.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dan Cho <dan.cho@acmefin.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Training on customer data - follow-up and next steps

Hi Marissa 

Thanks for the quick recap  that aligns with our needs. A few clarifying questions before we sign:

1) Data residency: When you say "pin... to EU regions", can you confirm processing and backups are restricted to EU-only (no cross-region replication to US)?
2) Logs & PII: Our PCI/PII policy requires that any logs retained for debugging must have PII redacted; are there fields that Redwood stores by default that might include customer PII (email, full name, payment tokens)?
3) Retention: We need a hard 30-day max retention for request/response logs. Is that configurable per-account and enforceable via policy?

Also, we need SOC 2 evidence and a short statement on whether the opt-out prevents usage of any telemetry or aggregated signals for model improvement.

Dan's on copy  he'll handle the procurement side once compliance signs off.

Regards,
Samantha Wu
Head of Platform Security | AcmeFin
Samantha.Wu@acmefin.com

[Attached: AcmeFin-Security-Questionnaire.xlsx]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Wu <samantha.wu@acmefin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Training on customer data - follow-up and next steps

Hi Samantha 

Thanks for the questions, happy to clarify. Short answers up top, details below:
- Residency: Yes, we can enforce EU-only processing and backups for your account. No cross-region replication will be enabled unless explicitly requested.
- PII in logs: By default, Redwood retains request/response logs to support debugging and billing; certain fields (raw user content) can include PII depending on your integration. We provide configurable redaction rules and a per-account flag to strip/replace email addresses, phone numbers, and payment tokens before logs persist.
- Retention: Retention windows are configurable per-account and enforceable. We can set and lock a 30-day max retention policy for request/response logs and aggregate telemetry.
- Training opt-out: We will set an account-level "training_opt_out" flag which excludes your traffic from any model training or improvement pools. This flag applies across hosted and dedicated modes where applicable. It does not remove ephemeral in-memory telemetry used for immediate request routing — only persisted data used by training pipelines is excluded.

Attachments I've included: SOC2-snapshot-2025.pdf (redacted copy of our SOC 2 report) and a link to the DocuSign for the opt-out form.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/links/abcdef123456
HubSpot (for reference): https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/contact/8421972

If you confirm the EU residency + 30-day retention, we'll: (1) send the DocuSign with pre-filled details, (2) set the training_opt_out flag after signature, and (3) schedule the SOC2/data-handling review with your security team if you want a short call.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

Attachments: SOC2-snapshot-2025.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Training on customer data - opt-out confirmation

Hi Samantha / Dan 

Thanks for confirming. Per Rishi's note and your confirmation, we've completed the following:

- DocuSign: Signed opt-out form processed (see attached opt-out-confirmation-DF-48391.pdf).
- Training opt-out: Account flag "training_opt_out" set on 2026-08-30T16:30:00Z; your traffic will be excluded from model training and improvement pools moving forward.
- Residency: Processing and backups restricted to EU regions only (no cross-region replication enabled).
- Retention: Request/response logs retention set and locked to 30 days; PII redaction rules applied to strip email addresses and payment tokens prior to persistence.
- Evidence: SOC 2 snapshot provided by Rishi; we can set up a short review call if you'd like deeper access.

Internal ticket: INF-7392 (set opt-out + retention + residency) — I'll mark this ticket as customer-verified on your confirmation.

Let us know if you'd like an executive primer for procurement or a short security walkthrough (we can do 20–30 minutes). Otherwise, I will follow up in 2 weeks to check on integration and any edge cases.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: opt-out-confirmation-DF-48391.pdf
